feature_name: OpenAI Partner Library Core Version Update
description: Update the OpenAI partner library to require a newer minimum version of the core library. This ensures compatibility with recent core library features and security updates while maintaining existing functionality.
functional_requirements: Update the pyproject.toml file to specify a higher minimum version for the core library dependency
Regenerate the lock file to reflect the updated dependency version
Ensure all existing OpenAI integration tests continue to pass with the new core version
